description: Search the public register of Legal Entity Identifiers by company name or LEI code: LEI, name, country, entity status, LEI registration status and link. Filter by entity status (active or inactive), LEI registration status and country. 1 point per returned record.

keyword.description: Company name or LEI. e.g. Apple

reg_status.description: LEI status. Options: ISSUED = Issued, LAPSED = Lapsed, ANNULLED = Annulled, MERGED = Merged, RETIRED = Retired, DUPLICATE = Duplicate, PENDING_TRANSFER = Pending transfer, PENDING_ARCHIVAL = Pending archival

status.description: Entity status. Options: active = Active, inactive = Inactive / dissolved

name: run_lei_lookup_companies_search
title: LEI Lookup companies search
